steps: The shared form preserves declared raw values. Optional restores start unselected, cannot remove required position, and cancellation leaves source/metadata/assets unchanged.
Deleting a null shared image declaration exposes the projection image dependency; an unavailable real image blocks approval and retains the restore intent without changing source.

One atomic position SET plus size/color/image RESET uses actual projection defaults, retains local overrides and identities, reviews all linked instances and full candidate, and survives three 390px locales before memory-only application.
Normal Save changes only the recipe; reopening keeps projection inheritance, local image/colour overrides, all stable IDs, groups and other author bytes.
A non-inheriting actor exposes only optional-image removal: it becomes imageless without changing its flag or allowing required runtime fields to be deleted.
A reset silently unchecked after approval invalidates application. An external source write after new mixed review is preserved by normal Save conflict handling alongside the local draft.
limitations: Real HTTP editor and Chrome only; no installed Tauri window or Android device acceptance.
One recipe shared actor optional-field removal and atomic mixed settings only. No required position removal, identity/structure/offset change, executable recipe build or cross-file transaction.
